title: Booking a Cancellation Charge against a Corporate Catering Service Agreement
content:
## When this applies

An order pulled under a Corporate Catering Service Agreement falls to carry a cancellation charge. The result this governs is the amount charged for that single cancellation, in USD.

## The condition the charge waits on

The cancellation charge is fixed only after a cancellation entry stands against the order, carrying the value the order held when notice was given.

While the order carries no cancellation entry of its own, no charge stands to be raised against it.

## What the desk does

The desk books the cancellation charge for that one order on the client's agreement. Once it is booked, a charge entry stands in the agreement's order history against that order reference, stamped with today as the day notice was given and with the day the catering was to have been served, and the agreement's unsettled catering balance stands higher by the amount charged. The client sees the charge on their next statement.

## Invoking the tool

The tool is `post_cancellation_charge_b7aa0639`. It is an agent-side tool: the desk unlocks it and then calls it, one call per pulled order charged.

## Parameters

| Parameter | What it is | Format |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `catering_agreement_id` | the reference number of the corporate catering service agreement being charged | an identifier, as returned by the catering agreement lookup |
| `customer_id` | the reference number of the client organisation profile the agreement belongs to | an identifier, as returned by the dining profile lookup |
| `order_reference` | the pulled catering order the charge answers, written as the order reference it carries throughout its history | CO- followed by 6 digits |
| `service_date` | the day the catering was to have been served, in the site's own calendar | YYYY-MM-DD; never left empty |
| `cancellation_charge_usd` | the amount charged for the cancellation | USD to 2 decimal places, rounded half to even at the point it is booked and never carried to a finer precision; no time zone applies and it is never left empty |

## What comes back

A confirmation sentence naming the invoice number the charge was filed under, the order reference charged and the amount booked in USD to two decimal places. The presence of the invoice number is what indicates the charge was raised; afterwards the order history shows one further cancellation charge entry and the agreement's unsettled catering balance stands higher by the amount booked.
